criterion: which entity type the entity named at the end of the text ("The entity type of X") belongs to

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: Individual human beings, including historical figures, celebrities, athletes, and fictional characters portrayed by actors.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: Geographical entities such as countries, cities, towns, bodies of water, mountains, and astronomical features.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: Groups of people formed for a shared purpose, including companies, institutions, government bodies, sports teams, and political parties.

categories.name: Creative Work
categories.definition: Artistic and intellectual productions such as films, books, songs, albums, plays, paintings, and television shows.

categories.name: Event
categories.definition: Occurrences happening at a specific time and place, including battles, wars, sports competitions, festivals, and historical incidents.

categories.name: Product
categories.definition: Manufactured goods, vehicles, technologies, currencies, and other tangible items produced for use or sale.

categories.name: Biological Entity
categories.definition: Living organisms including species of animals, plants, fungi, and specific biological molecules or anatomical structures.

categories.name: Demonyms and Groups
categories.definition: Terms referring to the people of a specific place (demonyms) or groups of people defined by ethnicity, nationality, or religion.

categories.name: Language
categories.definition: Systems of communication used by a specific community or nation.

categories.name: Award
categories.definition: Prizes, honors, or distinctions given to individuals or groups in recognition of achievement.

categories.name: Title and Position
categories.definition: Formal designations, ranks, or roles held by individuals within an organization, government, or social structure.

categories.name: Transport Infrastructure
categories.definition: Physical structures and systems used for transportation, including bridges, roads, railways, and airports.

categories.name: Chemical Substance
categories.definition: Chemical elements, compounds, drugs, and medications.

categories.name: Celestial Object
categories.definition: Natural objects in space such as stars, planets, moons, and asteroids.

categories.name: Geological Feature
categories.definition: Natural physical features of the earth's surface, including mountains, valleys, craters, and volcanoes.

categories.name: Software and Programming
categories.definition: Computer programs, operating systems, programming languages, and file formats.

categories.name: Award Category
categories.definition: Specific classifications or divisions within an award ceremony.

categories.name: Currency
categories.definition: Systems of money in general use in a particular country or monetary unit.

categories.name: Medical Condition
categories.definition: Diseases, disorders, syndromes, and other pathological conditions.
